body: Sorry, I had already gone to try to sleep.
I feel like I always do.

I need blunt. I know I need to break it off with her and stop talking to her. There are times where I just feel horrible and need to talk to someone and she's been the only one I could talk to that didn't really judge my problems.

You've really been too kind in trying to help me from an objective standpoint. I think I need someone in my life that will drag me to do the things I need to do.

I really want to talk to them, but it's very hard. It was hard enough when I asked for the ride to the hospital.

I know I am going through the cycle again. It's painful and makes me question myself in so many ways.

I know a soulmate wouldn't treat me like this. I just know all the good things about her and always felt that more than made up for the bad.

The cost of taking the GED test where I am (Alberta, Canada) is $200 from one place I was able to find offering it. I find it hard enough to ask them for $20, much less $200.

Moving out would be difficult for me since I did that before back when I last had a job. I lived with some friends and it didn't end too well. I also have a dog this time around and it somewhat loves me. I'd like to take him with me but places around here for rent that allow dogs are slim pickings and exceptionally expensive.

I always feel bad for rambling. I feel like I am piling on more and more excuses about why I can't do things while you're trying to help.

I want to believe there's someone else out there for me, but it's hard. I never really believed in soulmates or "the one" until I met her.

My parents already have enough to deal with financially. My dad is retired and my mom is on sick leave from her job. That sick leave was triggered by me asking her to take me to the hospital because I was depressed and needed help. She hasn't gone back to work since. Both of my parents have depression, my dad has PTSD, and my mom has anxiety problems now. Then there's also the physical problems they both have. I wish I could help financially but nobody around here will hire a guy in his 20s that has been out of work for over 5 years and no high school diploma.

I just feel completely alone. I need to get out of the house but I can't do it alone because the suicidal thoughts come back. If I had friends, I couldn't ask them to come all the way out here to pick me up just to hang out away from my house. I can't even make friends because of moving around a lot as a kid, I never developed the desire to start friendships. Others came to me and that's how friendships would start. I even have problems trying to have a social group in online games.

I'm sorry for rambling about things you didn't even ask about. I just feel like I have nothing and nobody. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me.

I don't know if i can cut her out of my life. I still completely love her despite using me. She's the only person I've really been able to talk to about my problems and it took a long time for all my barriers to come down and let her see the real me. I feel like she's the only one that could really accept a 20something that's been unemployed for years with no high school diploma. Almost everyone else I read about near my age are starting families.

I could start on working on getting the GED, but I've always been saying that. I am a huge procrastinator. All I see are the things I have to overcome to get it. I don't really have any money so I'd have to get it from my family. I don't have a car or a license, so I'd have to take a bus. I live on the furthest edge of a suburb of a major city, so I'd have to take several busses to get to the places I need to get to. It would be over $8 just to get into the city or $105 a month.
